text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock B and Stock D at gains felt rewarding, but my average cost is not a sound reason by itself to sell; I should focus on each stock’s prospects and my overall plan.","My account value moved up and down after my trades, and these short-term changes are not predictable from past prices or proof that a trade was right or wrong.","Because frequent checking can encourage impulsive trading, I should follow a consistent plan and not let the satisfaction of realizing gains or the discomfort of losses drive my decisions."]}
